overview: This breakout session of the Medford High School Building Project Community Forum focused on water efficiency and sustainable site design. Participants and project facilitators discussed landscape irrigation, invasive plant management, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and water-efficient fixtures.

items.title: Water Efficiency and Sustainable Sites Breakout Session
items.summary: Project facilitators and community members discussed goals for reducing potable water use through native landscaping, managing invasive species, distributing electric vehicle charging stations across the site, and utilizing water-efficient fixtures.
